MossyDell_Text_Npc0.en: PIKACHU likes the thick moss here.

MossyDell_Text_Npc1.en: It never gets dry in the dell.
MossyDell_Text_Npc1.fr: Il ne fait jamais sec dans le\nvallon.

MossyDell_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: Poison everywhere! Two ANTIDOTEs, a\nSILVER POWDER for you.
MossyDell_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Du poison partout ! Deux ANTIDOTES,\nune POUDRE ARGENT pour toi.

MossyDell_Text_Quest0_Done.en: Safe now! Take this SILVER POWDER.

MossyDell_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
MossyDell_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein ! Fais de la\nplace et reviens me voir.

MossyDell_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

MossyDell_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.

MossyDell_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
MossyDell_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Quelque chose brille ici, mais ton\nSAC est plein.
